capabilities.why: Provides isolated headless Chromium instances with full Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) connectivity and live viewer endpoints, allowing the autonomous agent to interact with untrusted DOM elements without host exposure.
Enforces pre-execution command interception hooks that evaluate all guest commands against security allow-lists and block prompt-injection exfiltration vectors before execution occurs.
Enables instant microVM memory and disk state capture before risky navigation flows, providing sub-50ms rollback capabilities when step 7 encounters deadlock without expensive cold VM reboots.
